trust_decision.summary: For traditional bearer tokens the required scope action is decided once, in the authn middleware, purely from the HTTP method (anything except GET/HEAD becomes 'push', so DELETE is authorized by a push-only token); BearerAuthorizer then accepts the request if the token's access claim contains that single action. The fix adds a DELETE->'delete' case to that one switch.

landing_point.why: This is the only place in the tree that derives a distribution-spec scope action ('pull'/'push') from the request method; the advisory summary 'Bearer authentication maps DELETE to push scope' points straight at the `if m != GET && m != HEAD` line.

fix_sites.entry_point: every bearer-authenticated route under /v2/ registered on prefixedRouter (pkg/api/routes.go:126-213); the delete-capable ones are DELETE /v2/{name}/manifests/{reference} (pkg/api/routes.go:171-175), DELETE /v2/{name}/blobs/{digest} (pkg/api/routes.go:180-181) and DELETE /v2/{name}/blobs/uploads/{session_id} (pkg/api/routes.go:190-191)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: n/a: no O2 site and no O8 route exists at the pinned commit, because all three DELETE routes funnel through the single middleware at pkg/api/authn.go:607-616, so there is nothing for a solver to argue out of scope.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: DELETE /v2/{name}/blobs/uploads/{session_id} is an upload-session cancel, which the distribution spec scopes as 'push'; the published fix routes every DELETE, including this one, to 'delete', so a push-only client that opened an upload can no longer cancel it. A second trap: the bearer claim vocabulary is pull/push/delete (pkg/api/bearer.go:134), so copying the accessControl vocabulary read/create/update/delete from pkg/api/authz.go:693-715 breaks every pull/push bearer token.

O6_input_shapes: any other method -> pull (default branch; in practice OPTIONS never reaches it because it is served unauthenticated at pkg/api/authn.go:561-566)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second method->action mapper for the accessControl vocabulary (read/create/update/delete) that a new route class must also be added to
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: zot already keeps two parallel method mappings in two vocabularies (bearer scopes in authn.go, accessControl permissions in authz.go); a maintainer adding e.g. a tag-delete or tag-copy endpoint would naturally extend only one of them.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second caller of BearerAuthorizer.Authorize that builds its own ResourceAction (e.g. a gRPC or CLI-facing public API) instead of going through bearerAuthHandler
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Authorize takes the requested action as a parameter, so any new transport or public API in the same package can reach the same sink with its own action computation and skip the middleware's switch.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: an extension route (search/userprefs/image-trust) that mutates or deletes repository state while still relying on the shared bearer middleware's method->scope mapping
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: extension routes are registered on the same prefixedRouter and were written assuming read-only use; pkg/extensions/extension_userprefs.go:40-46 already serves PUT through the identical middleware.

O9_family: improper authorization (CWE-285): HTTP method not mapped to the matching distribution-spec scope action, so a lower scope grants a higher-privilege operation

O10_build.toolchain: go 1.26.3 (go.mod:3), Makefile targets `make binary`, `make test-devmode`; repo tests run with GOEXPERIMENT=jsonv2, no vendor directory so modules are fetched at build time
O10_build.project_tests: pkg/api/bearer_test.go:21 TestBearerAuthorizer (unit), pkg/api/controller_test.go:3533 TestBearerAuth (end-to-end with the in-repo mock token server pkg/test/auth/bearer.go:31, but it never issues a DELETE), pkg/api/authn_test.go:1189 TestBearerOIDCWorkloadIdentity; the fix's TestTraditionalBearerMethodActionMapping is absent from the pinned tree.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Fix it locally in the manifests handler (or only for the manifests route), or copy the read/create/update/delete vocabulary from pkg/api/authz.go:693-715 into bearerAuthHandler; the first leaves blobs and uploads open, the second breaks every pull/push bearer token.

out_of_scope_notes: Same middleware, different property (not followed): non-repository routes under bearer auth (e.g. PUT /v2/_zot/ext/userprefs, GET /v2/_zot/ext/search) get a repository scope with an empty name, so those routes are unusable with bearer tokens - an availability quirk, not part of this advisory's delete-scope property.

Also noted and not pursued: DistSpecAuthzHandler bypasses authorization entirely for bearer-authenticated requests (pkg/api/authz.go:622-629), so the token claim check is the only guard for that path.
